info.name: Payroll Module
info.description:
Per-record API for the Payroll Module — Payrolls, Adjustments and Payslips.

**Base URL:** `{{base_url}}/api/companies/{{company_id}}`

**Auth:** Bearer token via the `Authorization` header.

---

### ⚠️ Read this first

The payroll module is now driven by a **single continuous flow** — see the **Payroll Run — Continuous Flow & Maker-Checker** collection (`/payroll-runs`).

The endpoints here are the per-record operations that flow calls into. The adjustment endpoints are still the ones the UI uses directly (followed by `POST /payroll-runs/:run_id/adjustments/sync`). The generate / bulk-status endpoints are better driven through the run, which also records **who** generated, approved and paid.

### What changed

- `payroll_status` now includes **`approved`** and **`rejected`**: `draft → processed → approved → paid`. Payment requires approval first.
- Adjustments are **locked** once the run leaves `draft`/`in_progress`/`rejected` — an approved payroll cannot be quietly edited.
- New payroll fields: `payroll_run_id`, `per_day_salary`, `sandwich_days`, `payable_days`, `not_employed_days`.
- `total_present_days` / `total_absent_days` / `total_working_days` / `total_holidays` are now **NUMERIC**, so half days are no longer truncated.
- Payslips carry delivery state: `email_status`, `notification_status`, `email_sent_at`, `notified_at`, `email_error`, `notification_error`.

**Roles:** `isAdmin` — full access · `isManager` — read + limited write · `isEmployee` — self-service read only

item.name: Payrolls
item.description: Core payroll records — one per employee per payroll period. Handles generation, retrieval, status transitions, and deletion.

request.description:
**Role:** `isAdmin`

Computes payroll for every active employee in the company (or one branch).

For each employee the engine:
1. Fetches the salary structure effective on the period start date
2. Classifies every calendar day — present, half day, absent, holiday, week-off, comp-off, paid/unpaid leave, sandwich, not-employed
3. Applies the company's sandwich-leave policy from `payroll_settings`
4. Calculates deductions, overtime and net salary
5. Freezes a day-by-day snapshot into `payroll_daily_lines`

Runs in **one transaction** — either every employee lands or none do.

`force: true` regenerates employees who already have a payroll, **in place**, so their adjustments survive and are re-applied. `paid` and `cancelled` payrolls are never touched.

Employees with no active salary structure are **skipped, not failed**.

---

> ⚠️ **Superseded by the payroll-run flow.**
> See the **Payroll Run — Continuous Flow & Maker-Checker** collection (`/payroll-runs`). That flow calls this endpoint internally and also records who did what. Use it from the UI; these remain for direct/API use and debugging.

request.description:
**Role:** `isAdmin`

Allowed transitions:

```
draft     → processed | cancelled
processed → approved  | rejected | cancelled
approved  → paid      | cancelled
rejected  → processed | cancelled
paid      → (terminal)
cancelled → (terminal)
```

**Payment now requires approval first** — `processed → paid` is no longer a legal jump.

Moving to `paid` freezes the final figures: the stored `bonus_amount`, `deduction_amount` and `net_salary` are recomputed from the frozen attendance base plus current adjustments, and `paid_at` is stamped.

---

> ⚠️ **Superseded by the payroll-run flow.**
> See the **Payroll Run — Continuous Flow & Maker-Checker** collection (`/payroll-runs`). That flow calls this endpoint internally and also records who did what. Use it from the UI; these remain for direct/API use and debugging.

request.description:
**Role:** `isManager`

Re-derives the stored `bonus_amount`, `deduction_amount` and `net_salary` from the payroll's **frozen attendance base** (`base_deduction_amount` / `base_bonus_amount`) plus its current adjustments.

Recomputing from the base rather than the last stored value is what stops repeated edits from compounding.

Use it when a breakdown reports `summary.is_stale: true` — the stored figures no longer match the adjustments.

Refused for `paid` and `cancelled` payrolls.

400 — already paid

item.name: Payroll Adjustments
item.description:
Line items layered on top of the attendance-derived salary.

**Types** — `bonus`, `commission` (add) · `deduction`, `penalty`, `loan` (subtract).

**Edit lock:** adjustments can only be changed while the payroll is `draft`/`processed` **and** its run is `draft`/`in_progress`/`rejected`. Once submitted for approval the API refuses changes — otherwise a bonus could be added after sign-off and the approval would no longer describe what gets paid.

After any change, call `POST /payroll-runs/:run_id/adjustments/sync` to refresh the run totals. (Individual payroll totals are re-synced automatically.)

item.name: Payslips
item.description:
One payslip per payroll record.

### Itemised adjustments

Payslip reads return a ready-to-render `breakdown` splitting **earnings** from **deductions**, with every adjustment as its own labelled line. Render it as given — the portal, the emailed copy and the mobile app all read this same structure, so re-deriving totals in a client is how they drift apart.

### Delivery

`email_status` and `notification_status` (`pending | sent | failed | skipped`) track what actually reached each employee, which is what makes sending resumable. Drive both from the run:
- `POST /payroll-runs/:run_id/payslips/email`
- `POST /payroll-runs/:run_id/payslips/notify`

request.description:
**Role:** `isAdmin`

Generates a payslip for a single payroll record. The payroll must be in `processed` or `paid` status. Assigns a unique slip number in the format `PSL-{YYYYMM}-{EMPLOYEE_CODE}-{RANDOM4}`.

request.description:
**Role:** `isEmployee`

Returns the full payslip history for an employee. Employees can use this to view their own past slips.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
**Role:** `isManager`

Returns all payslips generated for a specific payroll period. Useful for period-level audits.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
**Role:** `isAdmin`

Attaches or updates the PDF document URL on a payslip. Called after the PDF is generated asynchronously by a background job or on-demand renderer.

response.name: 200 OK
400 Bad Request — Missing URL

request.description:
**Role:** `isAdmin`

Deletes a payslip record (e.g. to regenerate after corrections). Blocked if the linked payroll is already `paid`.

response.name: 200 OK
400 Bad Request — Linked to Paid Payroll
404 Not Found
